title: The Runway Begins Here: Meet Omansh Gupta
excerpt: Nine years old and in Grade 3, Omansh Gupta is just beginning to discover what it feels like to own a room. His first runway walk came at a school Trash-to-Fashion competition. From there, he stepped into IBC Super Kids, a talent hunt for children aged 3 to 12, and found a new kind of excitement. With a family rooted in the event world and a confidence that is growing with every step, Omansh’s story is not about titles. It is about a young star finding his stride.
body:
Omansh Gupta, 9, on his first runway walk, a talent hunt debut, and the confidence of beginning

Young Talent Spotlight | IBC Celebrity & Lifestyle

Standfirst: Nine years old and in Grade 3, Omansh Gupta is just starting to discover what it feels like to own a room. His first steps on a ramp came in a school classroom turned catwalk. Now he has a talent hunt behind him, and plenty of curiosity left.

Every fashion story has a first moment, a single walk that changes how a person sees themselves. For Omansh Gupta, it came at school.

The occasion was a Trash-to-Fashion competition, where everyday discards were reimagined as wearable ideas. Omansh stepped onto the ramp for the very first time. The lights, the audience and the quiet before the first step all arrived at once, and he walked anyway. What began as a school activity became his first real taste of style, self-expression and the thrill of the stage.

That spark led him to IBC Super Kids, a modelling talent hunt for children aged 3 to 12. There, Omansh stood among young hopefuls from different backgrounds and got his first experience of a proper talent show: the preparation, the nerves and the excitement of waiting in the wings. For a nine-year-old, it was a first look at the wider world of fashion and entertainment.

Glamour is not entirely new to him. Omansh comes from an entrepreneurial family that runs its own event business, so celebrations, stage setups and presentations have always been part of his surroundings. Growing up near the craft of creating occasions may explain how comfortable he looks when all eyes turn his way.

Still, his story is not about trophies or titles, and it does not need to be. At nine, the real work is discovering who you are. Omansh is learning how to carry himself, how to hold his nerve and how to enjoy the moment, which are lessons that outlast any single show.

The road ahead is long and open. Fashion, modelling and entertainment are all there if he wants them, and he has all the time in the world to decide.

For now, one thing is certain. A first walk, a new platform and a growing confidence are enough to start with.

Omansh Gupta’s story is only beginning.

Celebrating young personalities, emerging talent and inspiring beginnings.

title: Diva: IBC Belleza Luxé Brings Its World of Style to OTT
excerpt: Every great magazine has a point of view. For IBC Belleza Luxé, it has always been simple: beauty is not a look, it is a way of carrying yourself. Now that idea is moving from the page to the screen with Diva, a new OTT reality show built around style, self-belief and the stories behind the glamour.
body:
Every great magazine has a point of view. For IBC Belleza Luxé, it has always been simple: beauty is not a look, it is a way of carrying yourself. Now that idea is moving from the page to the screen with Diva, a new OTT reality show built around style, self-belief and the stories behind the glamour.

More than a competition

Most reality shows ask who looks best. Diva asks a better question: who owns the room? Contestants are tested on fashion, grooming, poise, communication and creativity, but also on something harder to teach, which is presence. The show follows each participant through challenges, styling rounds and personal moments, so viewers see the person as well as the polish.

Where magazine meets screen

The same sections readers love on IBC Belleza Luxé shape the show’s world:

  • Fashion: styling challenges that reward individuality over trend-chasing.
  • Beauty: makeovers and skincare rituals that show confidence starts with care.
  • Lifestyle: real conversations about ambition, setbacks and reinvention.
  • Travel: striking locations that give every episode a distinct look.

Why OTT is the right home

Streaming lets Diva take its time. There is room for longer personal stories, behind-the-scenes moments and episodes viewers can watch whenever they choose. It also suits the audience IBC Belleza Luxé speaks to: readers who follow fashion on their phones and want entertainment that feels as considered as their wardrobe.

What viewers can expect

Expect bold styling, honest storytelling and a cast of contestants who bring very different backgrounds to the same stage. Diva celebrates the idea that elegance has many faces, and that anyone can learn to wear confidence well.

Stay with the story

Follow IBC Belleza Luxé for casting news, behind-the-scenes features and style guides inspired by the show. The magazine’s world is getting bigger, and Diva is its most glamorous step yet.
